title: OHOSMP
description: OhoSMP is a hardcore competitive Minecraft Survival SMP featuring economy, PvP, clans, events, and dangerous AI Hunters that roam the world hunting players and stealing loot.
body:
OHOSMP is a premium hardcore Minecraft Survival SMP built around danger, progression, competition, and long-term gameplay. Unlike generic survival servers, OhoSMP introduces custom AI Hunters that actively roam the world, attack players, hunt targets intelligently, and collect loot from defeated players. This creates constant tension and makes exploration, grinding, and survival far more intense.

The server combines competitive PvP, economy systems, clans, events, leaderboards, and progression into one connected experience. Every decision matters — whether you are building a hidden base, grinding wealth, fighting enemies, escaping AI Hunters, or dominating the server economy.

OhoSMP is designed for players who want survival to actually feel challenging and rewarding instead of easy and repetitive. With active development, custom systems, premium UI/UX, community-driven gameplay, and unique hardcore mechanics, the server delivers a highly addictive multiplayer experience where players create their own legends through skill, strategy, and survival.
